title: Roadblock to Innovation: The Role of Patent Litigation in Corporate R&D
eligible_reason: Single common event date with a continuous treatment: the Supreme Court decision eBay v. MercExchange (May 15, 2006; abstract and read_me). All DiD regressions (3_main_results.do, 4_main_results_publicfirms.do) are xtreg y c.exp_lit0006_2001shock##post, fe i(id), where exp_lit0006_2001shock is a continuous pre-period exposure to patent litigation by technology class and post is a common post-2006 indicator; richer columns add ind_time, state_time and pre-period characteristics x post. Figure dynamics use ib17.period##c.exposure. Continuous treatment, one adoption date: not an eligible design.
design_notes: Stata xtreg fe. Patent sample: firm (assignee) x pre/post or firm x quarter panel built from Fung Institute patent data; public-firm sample matched to Compustat (Compustat variables set to missing in the shipped data). Placebo samples shift the fake decision date (fin_placebo_*.dta).
data_files_note: Public patent data shipped; Compustat and CRSP variables removed (licensed).
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Continuous litigation-exposure x post-2006 design.
